title: A 4224 by 2816 file on XAVC HS 4K and XAVC S 4K at 23.98p and 25p and 29.97p: encoder request, two encoder cores, the 4K memory blocks in an order that holds the picture, descriptors, profiles and the monitoring label; the MP4 headers (tkhd, stsd, PROF) say 4224x2816
goes_with: dmm7slot_fx3_v1 (output planes), ogh2816_fx3_v1 (first stage 2832 rows passed one to one, sampling ratio 27/32) and outsz4224_fx3_v1 (output size), all in coprocessor RAM
encoder_cores: both (UseCore 2), as every stock descriptor above 249 million pixels a second
while_applied: only these coding rates are set up: 29.97p, 25p, 23.98p; the formats' other frame rates keep their 3840 by 2160 descriptors while the encoder request says 4224 by 2816: do not record them
the container and the metadata still say 3840 by 2160
the bit rate is the one the menu's record setting says
the MP4 headers of XAVC HS 4K and XAVC S 4K files say 4224x2816; Sony's XML in the file still says 3840x2160, 16:9
